result.instructions: Tools for Scaleway, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our instances are stopped in fr-par-1?"; "List the DNS records for example.com that point to an IP address."; "Show our Kubernetes clusters and their versions in every project.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Scaleway data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run scaleway_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run scaleway_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run scaleway_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. scaleway_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: scaleway_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects you can access, with their ids, names and organizations. Start here to get project ids for the other tools. Account API: GET /account/v3/projects.

organization_id.description: Only projects of this organization id.

tools.name: scaleway_list_servers
tools.title: List instances
tools.description: List compute instances (servers) in a zone, with state, commercial type and IPs. Instance API: GET /instance/v1/zones/{zone}/servers.

zone.description: Zone, for example fr-par-1, nl-ams-1 or pl-waw-1 (default fr-par-1).

tools.name: scaleway_get_server
tools.title: Get an instance
tools.description: Get one compute instance by id: state, type, image, volumes, public and private IPs and tags. Instance API: GET /instance/v1/zones/{zone}/servers/{server_id}.

zone.description: Zone, for example fr-par-1, nl-ams-1 or pl-waw-1 (default fr-par-1).

tools.name: scaleway_server_action
tools.title: Start, stop or reboot an instance
tools.description: Power an instance on (poweron), off (poweroff, a hard stop that can lose unsaved data) or reboot it (reboot). Billing continues while it runs. Instance API: POST /instance/v1/zones/{zone}/servers/{server_id}/action.

zone.description: Zone, for example fr-par-1, nl-ams-1 or pl-waw-1 (default fr-par-1).

annotations.title: Start, stop or reboot an instance

tools.name: scaleway_list_volumes
tools.title: List volumes
tools.description: List block volumes in a zone with their size, type and attached server. Instance API: GET /instance/v1/zones/{zone}/volumes.

zone.description: Zone, for example fr-par-1, nl-ams-1 or pl-waw-1 (default fr-par-1).

tools.name: scaleway_list_security_groups
tools.title: List security groups
tools.description: List instance security groups in a zone with their default inbound and outbound policies. Instance API: GET /instance/v1/zones/{zone}/security_groups.

zone.description: Zone, for example fr-par-1, nl-ams-1 or pl-waw-1 (default fr-par-1).

tools.name: scaleway_list_load_balancers
tools.title: List load balancers
tools.description: List load balancers in a zone with their status, type and IPs. Load Balancer API: GET /lb/v1/zones/{zone}/lbs.

zone.description: Zone, for example fr-par-1, nl-ams-1 or pl-waw-1 (default fr-par-1).

tools.name: scaleway_list_k8s_clusters
tools.title: List Kubernetes clusters
tools.description: List Kubernetes Kapsule clusters in a region with their status, version and type. Kubernetes API: GET /k8s/v1/regions/{region}/clusters.

region.description: Region, for example fr-par, nl-ams or pl-waw (default fr-par).

tools.name: scaleway_list_rdb_instances
tools.title: List managed database instances
tools.description: List managed PostgreSQL and MySQL database instances in a region with their engine, status and node type. Managed Database API: GET /rdb/v1/regions/{region}/instances.

region.description: Region, for example fr-par, nl-ams or pl-waw (default fr-par).

tools.name: scaleway_list_dns_zones
tools.title: List DNS zones
tools.description: List the DNS zones you manage in Scaleway Domains and DNS, with their domain names. Domain API: GET /domain/v2beta1/dns-zones.

dns_zone.description: Filter by DNS zone name, for example example.com.

tools.name: scaleway_list_dns_records
tools.title: List DNS records
tools.description: List the records of one DNS zone, optionally filtered by name or type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, ...). Domain API: GET /domain/v2beta1/dns-zones/{dns_zone}/records.

dns_zone.description: The DNS zone name, for example example.com (from scaleway_list_dns_zones).

type.description: Record type, for example A, AAAA, CNAME, MX or TXT.
